Embedder::embed_batch_impl embeds every input in ONE ORT batch padded to the longest text; with 8192-token models (nomic, bge-m3, gte-modernbert) a batch of long texts OOM-kills the process. Formatting only your own hunks in a file that is not rustfmt-clean: feed the file to rustfmt on stdin (`rustfmt --edition 2021 --emit stdout` with stdin input) so it does not follow `mod` declarations; the path form concatenates child modules and splices code, as in error 01M3JQHGXHZJRPF0E4FHQ4KX8N. Apply only the diff hunks that overlap your changed lines, then check `git diff -U0` hunk headers fall inside your regions.
